The glaze appears to 'melt' or bleed into the meat surface without a clear physical boundary or viscosity logic. In some areas, it looks like a flat texture overlay rather than a viscous liquid coating.
The background surface has a very slight, unnatural warp or blur gradient that doesn't perfectly align with the camera angle, suggesting minor generative inconsistency in the plane.
